Routine desk work for the Companion Animal Travel Desk

This section covers the day-to-day handling of companion animal travel requests at Aurelia Skyways. The goal is to keep each trip steady, kind, and fully coordinated across the desk, the gate, and the cabin team.

Start each case by checking the booking details, the animal's travel needs, and any notes from the passenger service record. Keep the language simple and calm when you speak with travelers, because many of them are already worried about their animal's comfort. Confirm that carrier details, document checks, and cabin placement requirements are complete before you move the request forward. If anything is missing, pause the process and ask for it right away, rather than trying to patch it later.

Work closely with the welcome team so the passenger hears the same guidance at every stage. The ground team must treat every carrier carefully and keep it upright, secure, and clear of heavy handling. The cabin team relies on clear handoff notes, so write in plain words and include anything that may affect animal monitoring in flight. If a pet shows signs of distress, if a carrier appears damaged, or if a traveler raises a concern at the desk, bring the issue to the senior coordinator without delay.

Do not promise changes that have not been checked. If a request needs review, say so honestly and explain the next step in simple terms. Keep records neat, current, and easy for the next colleague to follow. When several requests arrive at once, give priority to safety, then to correct paperwork, then to passenger convenience. A calm desk tone helps the whole operation stay organized, especially when animals, passengers, and crew are all moving through the same handoff points.

For any unclear case, contact the senior coordinator or the duty supervisor through the normal desk channel.
